Runtime / compiled dependencies:
- spdlog 1.15.3: MIT; logging.
  https://github.com/gabime/spdlog/tree/v1.15.3
- fmt 11.2.0 (bundled with spdlog): MIT with optional exception; formatting.
  License copied from the bundled format.h, not from an unrelated release.
  https://github.com/gabime/spdlog/tree/v1.15.3/include/spdlog/fmt/bundled
- nlohmann/json 3.12.0: MIT; JSON settings.
  https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0
- FreeType 2.14.3: used under the FreeType License (FTL), not the GPL alternative.
  Additional BDF, PCF, hash and bundled zlib notices are included below.
  https://freetype.org/
- HarfBuzz 14.2.0: Old MIT; text shaping. Microsoft USE notice also included.
  https://github.com/harfbuzz/harfbuzz/tree/14.2.0
- Volk: source supplied by Vulkan SDK 1.4.357.0; MIT; Vulkan function loading.
  https://github.com/zeux/volk
- Vulkan-Headers 1.4.357: the used C API headers are Apache-2.0 OR MIT;
  InputHalo elects MIT for those dual-licensed headers.
  Copyright 2015-2026 The Khronos Group Inc.
  https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers/tree/v1.4.357

Portions of this software are copyright © 2026 The FreeType Project
(https://freetype.org). All rights reserved.

Fonts are loaded from the user's Windows installation. Windows font files
are not bundled with InputHalo; their respective license terms continue to apply.
字体从用户的 Windows 系统读取，InputHalo 不随程序分发 Windows 字体文件。

Build-time tools (not bundled as application runtime executables):
CMake, Microsoft Visual C++ / Windows SDK, Vulkan SDK / DXC and Node.js / sharp
(icon generation). Their tool distributions retain their own license terms.
Vulkan loader and graphics drivers are provided by the user's system.
